Fetched /les-soldes.aspx directly: it is a pre-launch 'Soldes' (winter sales) landing/guide page for a future sale date, no product grid - excluded as editorial/promotional, not a PLP. Main nav has one strict-clearance-word link: 'Outlet' (/pplp/cat-1326.aspx), reached from the 'Bons plans' (deals) hub's Outlet tab. Opened it: title 'La Redoute Outlet : vetement pas cher - Les Aubaines', content is thin fashion-only marketing copy ('Jusqu'a -70% sur les marques femme'), and it silently drops the brndid=la-redoute-interieurs filter (same 'filter silently ignored on this node' pattern documented in the prior Home-Decor pass for other nodes) - not usable for this company. Within the 'Bons plans' hub, clicking the Outlet tab surfaces a 'La Redoute Interieurs' card linking to /pplp/cat-356660.aspx ('Collection La Redoute Interieurs') - opened this: it is a curated multi-carousel brand showcase (sections: Linge de Maison, Canape/fauteuil, Table/chaise, Lit/literie, Meuble, Decoration, Jardin, plus editorial buckets 'Les Irresistibles'/'Les ingenieux'/'Les Signatures'/'Les nouveautes'/'Les Tendances') with NO product-count element and NO pagination (confirmed via DOM scan - only stray analytics numbers found, no 'Page X sur Y'), and every single item on it is tagged 'French Days' (the live seasonal campaign) - this is a promo landing page, not a flat PLP. Followed its 'best of maison' outlet-card link with brndid=la-redoute-interieurs to /pplp/cat-416035.aspx: page title is literally 'Le best of maison French Days LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS' (count shown: 77) - the word 'French Days' in the title itself confirms this is the current temporary seasonal campaign, not a permanent outlet/clearance listing, despite being reached via the site's 'Outlet' nav label. Checked footer and homepage DOM for any Soldes/Destockage/Fin de serie/Outlet/Last-chance links via a regex scan of all anchor text - only the one generic 'Outlet' link (above) was found; no dedicated Decoration/Luminaire/Meuble clearance sub-nav exists. CONCLUSION: no genuine permanent-markdown/outlet-style Clearance PLP exists for La Redoute Interieurs on laredoute.fr at this time - every 'Outlet'-labeled path resolves to the live French Days seasonal promotion. Recording zero rows per brief guidance (a correct, valuable absence answer) rather than misclassifying a seasonal sale as Clearance.
